claims.statement: Pinned APS manifest members rehash exactly.
claims.classification_rule: Rehash every manifest-declared APS fixture member.

claims.statement: The PriorSeal APS copy is byte-identical to the pinned APS owner fixture set.
claims.classification_rule: Require identical manifest bytes and all 17 owner-declared fixture bytes.

claims.statement: Permit receipts verify under the pinned APS fixture test keys only.
claims.classification_rule: Verify receipt IDs and Ed25519 signatures against fixture test-key pins.

claims.statement: Permit delegation verifies under the pinned APS fixture test key only.
claims.classification_rule: Verify delegation ID and Ed25519 signature against the fixture test-key pin.

claims.statement: Permit decision_ref is bound to its action, authority, policy, context, and decision output.
claims.classification_rule: Recompute the APS decision_ref from the pinned fixture evidence.

claims.statement: Permit decision is temporally valid at the fixed reference time.
claims.classification_rule: Compare valid_until to 2026-09-19T10:05:00.000Z.

claims.statement: Expired fixture is temporally valid at the fixed reference time.
claims.classification_rule: Compare expired valid_until to the fixed reference time; expected result is CONTRADICTED.

claims.statement: Deny fixture carries a deny decision verdict.
claims.classification_rule: Require decision.result.verdict == deny.

claims.statement: PriorSeal principal EIP-712 authorization verifies for the pinned fixture.
claims.classification_rule: Reconstruct typed data and recover the pinned fixture authorizer.

claims.statement: PriorSeal issuer acceptance verifies for the pinned fixture.
claims.classification_rule: Verify acceptance hash bindings and Ed25519 signature under the pinned fixture issuer key.

claims.statement: Positive PriorSeal execution receipt verifies for the pinned fixture.
claims.classification_rule: Verify receipt hashes and issuer signature for the pinned positive fixture.

claims.statement: Over-limit PriorSeal execution receipt verifies for the pinned fixture.
claims.classification_rule: Verify receipt hashes and issuer signature for the pinned over-limit fixture.

claims.statement: PriorSeal authorization is bound to the pinned APS decision_ref.
claims.classification_rule: Require exactly one APS decision-ref commitment matching the APS permit decision_ref.

claims.statement: Positive fixture observation exactly agrees with the authorized call.
claims.classification_rule: Compare chain, target, calldata hash, and native value.

claims.statement: Positive fixture observation is within the APS per-action cap.
claims.classification_rule: Compare observed native value to the APS delegated spend cap.

claims.statement: Over-limit fixture observation exactly agrees with the authorized call.
claims.classification_rule: Compare observed native value to the authorized transaction value; expected result is CONTRADICTED.

claims.statement: Over-limit fixture observation is within the APS per-action cap.
claims.classification_rule: Compare observed native value to the APS delegated spend cap; expected result is CONTRADICTED.

claims.statement: A live-chain execution occurred.
claims.classification_rule: This fixture-only procedure does not establish live execution occurrence.

claims.statement: The APS decision_ref was durably consumed exactly once.
claims.classification_rule: Receipt verification does not establish durable decision consumption.

claims.statement: APS enforced live-currency spend state.
claims.classification_rule: Fixture-local EVM mapping and synthetic spend state are not live enforcement.

claims.statement: An independent external witness observed the payment execution.
claims.classification_rule: Both payment observations are producer fixtures.

claims.statement: The composed system is deployed or adopted in production.
claims.classification_rule: A bounded interoperability fixture does not establish deployment or endorsement.

negative_controls.description: The expired APS fixture must contradict temporal validity at the fixed reference time.
The over-limit observation must contradict exact agreement with the authorized call.
The over-limit observation must contradict APS cap compliance.

limitations: APS authenticity statements are limited to verification under the pinned fixture test keys; production identity and production key control are not established.
The formal fixture run does not establish live-chain execution, durable APS decision single-use, live-currency enforcement, an independent external witness, production adoption, or endorsement.
Mutation/corpus adequacy is excluded until discriminating fixtures exist and that stage is separately approved.
A valid reproduction record is an operator record only until separately admitted to a shared record; publication is a separate decision.
